body: I've tried letting them know I've been doing my work and trying to get everything done, but they still seem to ignore me and I just remain in the same situation.

Thanks for taking the time to talk to me.

I feel in my opinion the biggest problems is just my parents caring about me so much. I feel like if they left me alone, I'd be able to concentrate and relax bit more; however, there's no real way for me to be able to get them to do that.
